title: Checkpoint 2 — Your First Blink
description: Quick check after Build #1: blinking the onboard LED.

questions.prompt: In Arduino-style code, when does the setup() function run?
choices: Once, right when the board starts up
Only when you press a button
questions.explanation: setup() runs once at boot — it's where you get pins and Serial ready.

choices: It repeats over and over, forever
It runs once at the end
It only runs if setup() fails
questions.explanation: loop() runs again and again — that's what makes the LED blink continuously.
HIGH sends power to the pin (LED on); LOW turns it off.

questions.prompt: How long does delay(500) pause the program?
questions.explanation: delay() is in milliseconds, so 500 = half a second.

questions.prompt: To read the messages your board prints, what must the Serial Monitor's baud rate be set to?
questions.explanation: We call Serial.begin(115200), so the monitor must match 115200 or you'll see gibberish.
